sentences.text:
The instant petition has been filed by the petitioners seeking a direction to respondent no. 2 i.e.
Special Land Acquisition Officer, Joint Organization, Bulandshahar to pay ex-gratia amount to the petitioners having regard to the assignment deed dated 19.04.2012 executed in their favour by respondent no. 4.
3.

entities.text: Special Land Acquisition Officer, Joint Organization,
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: It seems that the compensation for the acquired land of respondent no. 4 was enhanced under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by judgement dated 27.4.2012.
The execution application of the petitioners for payments of the compensation amount is pending before the court.

The case of the petitioners is that they have already been paid the compensation amount as determined under the original award, however the enhanced compensation amount has not been released in their favour so far and hence the instant petition.
4. Since the matter is pending before the executing court, therefore, we refrain from making any comment or issuing any direction.

We leave it open to the petitioners to make appropriate application before the executing court, if not already made for release of the enhanced amount and in which event, the said application would be decided by the executing court, in accordance with law.
5. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
